changelog:
- Initial release of the mta skill providing real-time NYC MTA transit information.
- Supports subway arrivals, bus predictions (requires API key), service alerts, and route details for the New York City subway and bus system.
- Commands cover arrivals, vehicle locations, service alerts, route and stop lookup, and GTFS data refresh.
- Zero configuration needed for subway and alert features; bus-related features require an MTA_BUS_API_KEY.
- Includes reference data on subway lines, key bus routes, and fare information.
